components.name: Primary Button

components.name: Field
components.description: Labelled booking field: label above, value below.
components.css: .ds-field { display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:2px; min-height:66px; padding:10px 16px; border:1px solid #7E979A; border-radius:14px; background:#fff; font-family: Figtree, system-ui, sans-serif; transition:border-color .2s, box-shadow .2s; } .ds-field:hover { border-color:#2E474B; } .ds-field:focus-within { border-color:#156970; box-shadow:0 0 0 1px #156970,0 0 0 5px rgba(21,105,112,.16); } .ds-l { font-weight:600; font-size:13px; color:#4F676B; } .ds-i { border:0; outline:0; padding:0; height:30px; font:650 17px/30px Figtree, system-ui, sans-serif; color:#0B2B30; background:transparent; } .ds-i::placeholder { color:#5E7478; font-weight:500; }

components.name: Trip Control
components.description: Segmented trip type control on the deep teal card header.
components.html: Choose your route
components.css: .ds-head { display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; gap:16px; padding:14px 16px 14px 24px; border-radius:28px 28px 0 0; background:#0F555B; color:#fff; } .ds-t { font-family: Manrope, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight:700; font-size:19px; } .ds-seg { display:inline-flex; gap:2px; padding:4px; border-radius:12px; background:rgba(255,255,255,.14); } .ds-s { padding:8px 14px; border:0; border-radius:8px; background:transparent; color:rgba(255,255,255,.92); font-family: Figtree, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight:650; font-size:15px; cursor:pointer; } .ds-s.on { background:#fff; color:#0F555B; font-weight:750; box-shadow:0 1px 3px rgba(11,43,48,.3); }

components.name: Route Entry
components.description: Signature: chosen airports as departure-board entries joined by a connector.
components.css: .ds-route { position:relative; border:1px solid #7E979A; border-radius:14px; background:#fff; } .ds-route::before { content:''; position:absolute; left:27px; top:34px; bottom:34px; border-left:2px solid #C94300; } .ds-row { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:12px; padding:14px 16px 14px 58px; } .ds-row + .ds-row { border-top:1px solid #D5E3E2; } .ds-row b { font-family: Manrope, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight:800; font-size:26px; color:#0B2B30; } .ds-row span { display:grid; font-family: Figtree, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight:650; font-size:15px; line-height:1.15; color:#0B2B30; } .ds-row small { font-weight:400; font-size:13px; color:#4F676B; }

components.name: Moment Stage
components.description: Pastel stage holding one fetched illustration with a moment tag.
components.css: .ds-stage { position:relative; width:260px; aspect-ratio:1/1.04; border-radius:28px; background:#FBE5D4; } .ds-tag { position:absolute; left:16px; top:16px; padding:6px 12px; border-radius:999px; background:#fff; color:#0B2B30; font-family: Figtree, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight:650; font-size:13px; box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(11,43,48,.1); }

components.name: Featured Review
components.css: .ds-rev { margin:0; padding:32px; border-radius:28px; background:#0F555B; color:#fff; font-family: Figtree, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-rev blockquote { margin:0 0 16px; font-weight:500; font-size:24px; line-height:1.42; } .ds-rev figcaption { font-size:14px; color:rgba(255,255,255,.78); }

narrative.overview:
Onward Sky is drawn as a bright departure hall: pale teal daylight, a traveler on a phone with her luggage and a plane overhead, and a booking card that is the counter she steps up to. It keeps the brand's friendly identity (teal, the production orange, Figtree) and adds weight where a premium service needs it: confident Manrope headlines, a deep teal card header, real airline marks and illustration with a human in it.

Density is calm. Large type, generous space, and surfaces that change color by meaning: pale teal for the welcome, deep teal for the instrument and the proof, white for reading, four pastel stages for the four moments. Motion is one gentle entrance on load; after that, only answers to input.

Everything that looks drawn was fetched. Illustrations come from the unDraw collection and are only recolored; icons are Phosphor; airline and payment marks come from Soaring Symbols and Simple Icons; the full record is in `assets/SOURCES.md`.
keyCharacteristics: Pale teal stage with one large soft halo behind the booking card and a faint vector atlas behind the traveler.
Deep teal as the committed dark: the card header, the airline band and the featured review.
Burnt orange appears only on actions (and on the plotted connector once a route is set).
Manrope 800 for headlines, prices and airport codes; Figtree for sentences and controls.
Fetched illustration, recolored to brand teal, ink and a peach accent; the figure stands on a real edge (the band).

rules.name: The One Hot Color Rule
rules.body: Burnt orange marks what happens next (the action, the route) and nothing else: never a heading, badge or background wash.

rules.name: The Boundary Rule
rules.body: A control's edge uses control-line (3:1 minimum); hairline is for decoration and never the only boundary of something a person operates.

rules.name: The Fetched Art Rule
rules.body: Illustration, icons, logos and maps are fetched from open libraries and only recolored or cropped. Nothing figurative is drawn by hand; every source is recorded with its license.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Manrope carries headings, prices and codes; Figtree carries sentences and controls. Never a paragraph in Manrope or a heading in Figtree.

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: Labels, buttons and headings are sentence case; only airport and airline codes are capitals.

rules.name: The Instrument Rule
rules.body: Only things you can operate float. Content panels sit on their ground with a tint or a hairline, never a shadow.

dos: Do keep the booking card the brightest, most finished object in the first viewport.
Do break the display headline on meaning ("Get a verifiable / onward ticket / in 2 minutes.").
Do fetch every illustration, icon, logo and map from an open library, recolor it to the palette, and record the source.
Do give every control a 44px minimum target and a control-line boundary.
Do answer input with motion (route connector, swap turn, flight added) and show final states under reduced motion.
donts: Don't hand-draw illustrations, icons or logos.
Don't put eyebrow labels or kickers above headings.
Don't use burnt orange for decoration, emphasis words or headings.
Don't set the display face as body copy, or Figtree as a headline.
Don't hide the booking form behind a button, modal or second page.
